summary_en: The EF App Enablement team asked app teams that rarely join ACD calls for their input, and a Magicians post summarized interviews with staking and oracle teams about EIPs and the roadmap. ethbeat reviewed 16 privacy protocols for what they actually hide, from whom, and what stays visible. EIP-7906 clarified where storage-kept nonce changes appear, and ChainSecurity invited projects to walk through their call paths at Devcon.
